title: When Stored Evidence Stops Being Usable: Scale-Conditioned Evaluation of Agent Memory
abstract: arXiv:2605.07313v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Memory-agent evaluations report fixed-snapshot accuracy or retrieval quality, but these scores do not show whether evidence remains usable as irrelevant sessions (sessions not annotated as task-relevant evidence for the query) accumulate. We present a scale-conditioned evaluation protocol for agent memory under evidence-preserving growth: for each query, task evidence is held fixed while irrelevant sessions are added. The protocol logs agent-memory trajectories and reports four diagnostics: budget-compliant reliability, tail memory-call burden, failure-regime decomposition, and the usable-scale boundary where reliability falls below the target. Applied to LongMemEval and LoCoMo across flat, planar, and hierarchical memory interfaces, the protocol shows reliability loss is not a single phenomenon. translated_title: 当存储的证据不再可用时：面向规模的智能体记忆评估
translated_abstract: arXiv:2605.07313v2 公告类型：替换。摘要：记忆-智能体评估通常报告固定快照下的准确率或检索质量，但这些分数无法表明当无关会话（即未被标注为与查询任务相关证据的会话）不断累积时，证据是否仍然可用。我们提出了一种在证据保持增长条件下、面向规模的智能体记忆评估协议：对于每个查询，任务证据保持固定不变，同时逐步添加无关会话。该协议记录智能体-记忆的运行轨迹，并报告四项诊断指标：符合预算的可靠性、尾部记忆调用负担、失效模式分解，以及可靠性跌破目标值时的可用规模边界。该协议应用于LongMemEval和LoCoMo数据集，涵盖平坦型、平面型和层级型三种记忆接口，结果显示可靠性损失并非单一现象。在LongMemEval上，HippoRAG保持在两次调用的预算之内，但随着无关会话的累积，其符合预算的可靠性下降了16-20个百分点……
tldr: 该论文提出一种面向规模的智能体记忆评估协议，在任务证据固定不变的前提下逐步累积无关会话，并通过四项诊断指标揭示记忆系统的可靠性损失并非单一现象（例如HippoRAG在LongMemEval上随无关会话增加损失16-20个百分点的符合预算可靠性）。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a scale-conditioned evaluation protocol for agent memory that holds task evidence fixed while incrementally adding irrelevant sessions, revealing through four diagnostics that reliability loss is not a single phenomenon (e.g., HippoRAG loses 16-20 percentage points of budget-compliant reliability on LongMemEval as irrelevant sessions accumulate).
